evidence.title: Exploring The Potential Of Web Workers For Multithreading On The Web — Smashing Magazine

name: Exploring The Potential Of Web Workers For Multithreading On The Web
summary: Smashing Magazine article on using Web Workers to run JavaScript off the main thread, with limits and workarounds.
description: A 17-minute article by Sarah Oke Okolo (April 21, 2023) on why JavaScript's single thread blocks the UI and how Web Workers execute code in a background thread. It walks through creating a worker, the postMessage messaging API, what workers cannot touch (DOM, localStorage), and strategies for mitigating those limitations in performance-critical apps.
